topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I can't stop thinking about this manuscript, these pages filled with my life, but not by my hand. We spend every minute together, or so I thought. How does one keep such a secret? Every word, every chapter — it’s me, but through his eyes, through his imagination. I can't help but wonder what else he's kept from me. I need to know what he's trying to say, what he's really feeling. I have to talk to him, but the thought of it makes my heart race. What if this changes everything? What if it’s a story I don't want to read?
